title: Design and synthesis of new coumarin-based fluorescent chemosensors for the dual detection of Hg2+ and Cu2+ in aqueous and biological samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44611-44622
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05643H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wahaj Raed Abbas, Mohammed Abed Kadhim
New coumarin-based probes (1a–1d) enable highly selective, sensitive, and rapid dual detection of Hg2+ and Cu2+ in water and blood serum, useful for environmental and biomedical applications.
